stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: Drohnenangriffe im ukrainisch-polnischen Grenzgebiet gemeldet +++ Entwarnung in Litauen: Vermeintliche Drohnensichtung entpuppt sich als Vogelschwarm

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: Drone attacks reported in Ukrainian-Polish border area +++ All-clear in Lithuania: Suspected drone sighting turns out to be flock of birds
en.summary: Russia continues military operations against Ukraine after more than four years. Recent reports include drone attacks near the Ukrainian-Polish border and a false alarm in Lithuania involving a bird sighting.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Cassis: Wollen Friedensgespräche wieder in Schwung bringen

en.title: War in Ukraine – Cassis: Want to get peace talks back on track
en.summary: Switzerland's security adviser travelled to Kyiv and Moscow in August to conduct discussions aimed at reviving peace negotiations regarding the Ukraine conflict.

stories.title: Faire du vélo en Suisse est deux fois plus dangereux qu'aux Pays-Bas

en.title: Cycling in Switzerland is twice as dangerous as in the Netherlands
en.summary: Research from the University of Twente and ETH Zurich found that bicycle accidents occur twice as frequently in Switzerland compared to the Netherlands. Researchers identified public transport stops, tram tracks, and intersections as key problem areas.

stories.title: Angriff auf die Lebensader: Nach einer Drohnenattacke ist Saudiarabiens wichtigste Pipeline ausser Betrieb

en.title: Attack on the lifeline: Saudi Arabia's main pipeline shut down after drone attack
en.summary: Multiple drones originating from Iraq attacked Saudi Arabia's east-west pipeline overnight Saturday, forcing it out of service. The incident represents another escalation in the economic conflict in the Gulf region.

stories.title: 250 bovins périssent dans un incendie à Palézieux

en.title: 250 cattle die in farm fire at Palézieux
en.summary: A fire at a farm in Palézieux destroyed a barn and killed or led to the euthanasia of approximately 250 animals, mainly calves. No human injuries were reported.

stories.title: Audrey Werro wins inaugural Ultimate Championship 800m title

en.title: Audrey Werro wins inaugural Ultimate Championship 800m title
en.summary: Swiss runner Audrey Werro won the first Ultimate Championship 800-metre race in Budapest with a time of 1:55.88, earning $150,000 in prize money and extending her unbeaten outdoor season streak.

stories.title: Des centaines de bovins tués dans l'incendie d'une grande ferme à Palézieux (VD)

en.title: Hundreds of cattle killed in fire at large farm in Palézieux (VD)
en.summary: A fire at a farm in Palézieux on Saturday evening killed 250 animals with no human casualties. The fire was brought under control Sunday morning, and the cause remains unknown.

stories.title: Ultimate Championship – Entfesselte Werro siegt auch in Budapest

en.title: Ultimate Championship – Werro wins decisively again in Budapest
en.summary: Audrey Werro won the 800-meter race at the Ultimate Championship in Budapest with a commanding performance.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - Die neuen Herren der Finanzmärkte: «KI-Agenten können die Notenbanken in die Enge treiben», sagt der Princeton-Professor Markus Brunnermeier

en.title: INTERVIEW - The new masters of financial markets: "AI agents can corner central banks," says Princeton professor Markus Brunnermeier
en.summary: Autonomous AI systems are gaining power in financial markets, but their decision-making processes remain opaque. Economist Markus Brunnermeier warns this opacity poses risks to financial stability.

stories.title: Er wirkte blass und distanziert. Trotzdem hatte der neue Apple-Chef John Ternus einen guten ersten Auftritt

en.title: He appeared pale and distant. Still, new Apple CEO John Ternus had a good first appearance
en.summary: John Ternus, known for Apple's high-margin hardware, made his debut as CEO by presenting a foldable iPhone, marking a successful first public appearance despite his reserved demeanor.

stories.title: Die Spekulanten werden die Entschlossenheit von US-Finanzminister Scott Bessent testen

en.title: Speculators will test the resolve of US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent
en.summary: Former hedge fund manager Scott Bessent challenged investors this week to bet against his market interventions, a stance that could lead to significant consequences.

stories.title: Bitcoin feiert ein Comeback – oder handelt es sich bloss um ein Strohfeuer?

en.title: Bitcoin celebrates a comeback – or is it just a flash in the pan?
en.summary: Bitcoin's price has risen sharply in a short period, with analysts considering two very different scenarios for what may happen next.
